text_en: It happened also that seven brothers and their mother were arrested and were being compelled by the king, under torture with whips and thongs, to partake of unlawful swine’s flesh.
text_cn: 事后，又有兄弟七人与他们的母亲一同被捕，国王命人用鞭子和牛筋痛打他们，强迫他们吃法律禁止的猪肉。

text_en: One of them, acting as their spokesman, said, “What do you intend to ask and learn from us? For we are ready to die rather than transgress the laws of our ancestors. ”
text_cn: 其中一个，代表发言说：“你想问什么？你愿由我们知道什么？我们已经准备，宁死不愿背叛我们祖先的法律。”

text_en: The king fell into a rage, and gave orders to have pans and caldrons heated.
text_cn: 于是国王大怒命人取过锅釜来，放在火上。

text_en: These were heated immediately, and he commanded that the tongue of their spokesman be cut out and that they scalp him and cut off his hands and feet, while the rest of the brothers and the mother looked on.
text_cn: 及至锅釜（fǔ）瞬息间烧红以后，就命人在其余的兄弟和母亲眼前，将那发言人的舌头割下来，剥去他的头皮，割下他的四肢，

text_en: When he was utterly helpless, the king ordered them to take him to the fire, still breathing, and to fry him in a pan. The smoke from the pan spread widely, but the brothers and their mother encouraged one another to die nobly, saying,
text_cn: 肢体被分割后，王命人将他拉到火边，活生生地放在锅里煎熬。当锅内的蒸气往上升起时，其余的兄弟和母亲都互相劝勉作壮烈的牺牲说：

text_en: “The Lord God is watching over us and in truth has compassion on us, as Moses declared in his song that bore witness against the people to their faces, when he said, ‘And he will have compassion on his servants. ’”
text_cn: “上主天主看见，必要怜恤我们，正如梅瑟在谴责歌中所说的：他必怜恤自己的仆人！”

text_en: After the first brother had died in this way, they brought forward the second for their sport. They tore off the skin of his head with the hair, and asked him, “Will you eat rather than have your body punished limb by limb? ”
text_cn: 第一个这样死去以后，遂领第二个来赴刑。将他的头皮与头发一起削去，以后问他说：“在你的身体一块一块地分解以前，你吃不吃猪肉？”

text_en: He replied in the language of his ancestors and said to them, “No. ” Therefore he in turn underwent tortures as the first brother had done.
text_cn: 他用祖国的话答说： “不！”因此，他也像第一个一般受了刑罚。

text_en: And when he was at his last breath, he said, “You accursed wretch, you dismiss us from this present life, but the King of the universe will raise us up to an everlasting renewal of life, because we have died for his laws. ”
text_cn: 他在快要断气的一刹那，高声说：“你这穷凶极恶的人！你使我失去现世的生命，但是宇宙的君王，必要使我们这些为他的法律而殉难的人复活，获得永生。”

text_en: After him, the third was the victim of their sport. When it was demanded, he quickly put out his tongue and courageously stretched forth his hands,
text_cn: 这一个以后，轮到第三个受刑了！在命他伸舌头时，他就爽快地伸出，且毅然伸开双手，

text_en: and said nobly, “I got these from Heaven, and because of his laws I disdain them, and from him I hope to get them back again. ”
text_cn: 慷慨地说：“这些肢体是从上天得来的，但是，现在为了他的法律，我不吝啬这一切，希望有一天从他那里仍再得到。”

text_en: As a result the king himself and those with him were astonished at the young man’s spirit, for he regarded his sufferings as nothing.
text_cn: 国王和他的侍从都惊异这少年人不怕受苦的精神。

text_en: After he too had died, they maltreated and tortured the fourth in the same way.
text_cn: 他死了以后，他们用同样酷刑处罚第四个。

text_en: When he was near death, he said, “One cannot but choose to die at the hands of mortals and to cherish the hope God gives of being raised again by him. But for you there will be no resurrection to life! ”
text_cn: 他临死时这样说：“深信天主使人复活许诺的人，死在人手中，是求之不得的；可是为你，却没有进入生命的复活。”

text_en: Next they brought forward the fifth and maltreated him.
text_cn: 接着，人就带第五个来受刑。

text_en: But he looked at the king, and said, “Because you have authority among mortals, though you also are mortal, you do what you please. But do not think that God has forsaken our people.
text_cn: 他向国王瞪着眼说：“你这有死有坏的人，现今你对人有权柄，为所欲为；可是，不要想我们的民族已被天主摈弃。

text_en: Keep on, and see how his mighty power will torture you and your descendants! ”
text_cn: 你等着看罢！你必要看见他的大能，看他要怎样惩罚你和你的子孙！”

text_en: After him they brought forward the sixth. And when he was about to die, he said, “Do not deceive yourself in vain. For we are suffering these things on our own account, because of our sins against our own God. Therefore astounding things have happened.
text_cn: 在他以后，带了第六个来，他快死时说：“你不要糊涂自欺！我们遭受这一切，正是因为我们得罪了我们的天主，因而遭受了这样严重的灾难。

text_en: But do not think that you will go unpunished for having tried to fight against God! ”
text_cn: 可是，你不要想你对抗天主，能侥幸免罚！”

text_en: The mother was especially admirable and worthy of honorable memory. Although she saw her seven sons perish within a single day, she bore it with good courage because of her hope in the Lord.
text_cn: 尤当称奇，最值得光荣记念的，还是他们的母亲。她在一日之内亲见七个儿子死去，还能欣然忍受，因为她全心寄望于上主。

text_en: She encouraged each of them in the language of their ancestors. Filled with a noble spirit, she reinforced her woman’s reasoning with a man’s courage, and said to them,
text_cn: 她心中充满高尚的情绪，以大丈夫的气概奋发起女性孱（chán）弱的心灵，用本国的话，一一鼓励他们说：

text_en: “I do not know how you came into being in my womb. It was not I who gave you life and breath, nor I who set in order the elements within each of you.
text_cn: “我不知你们怎样出现在我的腹中：不是我给了你们灵魂与生命，也不是我构成了你们每一个人的身体。

text_en: Therefore the Creator of the world, who shaped the beginning of humankind and devised the origin of all things, will in his mercy give life and breath back to you again, since you now forget yourselves for the sake of his laws. ”
text_cn: 世界的创造者，既然形成了人的初生，赐予万物以起源，也必仁慈偿还你们的灵魂和生命，因为你们现在为爱护他的法律舍生致命。

text_en: Antiochus felt that he was being treated with contempt, and he was suspicious of her reproachful tone. The youngest brother being still alive, Antiochus not only appealed to him in words, but promised with oaths that he would make him rich and enviable if he would turn from the ways of his ancestors, and that he would take him for his Friend and entrust him with public affairs.
text_cn: 安提约古自觉受了轻慢，猜想这番话必是讽刺自己，就趁最幼的一个尚在，不断用话劝诱，且向他起誓，只要他弃舍自己祖传的一切，保证他必享富贵幸福，作自己的朋友，且得高官厚禄。

text_en: Since the young man would not listen to him at all, the king called the mother to him and urged her to advise the youth to save himself.
text_cn: 可是，少年人对这话毫不介意，因此王就召他的母亲来，劝她给少年人出个得救的主意。

text_en: After much urging on his part, she undertook to persuade her son.
text_cn: 国王再三劝了她，她才同意去劝说自己的儿子。

text_en: But, leaning close to him, she spoke in their native language as follows, deriding the cruel tyrant: “My son, have pity on me. I carried you nine months in my womb, and nursed you for three years, and have reared you and brought you up to this point in your life, and have taken care of you.
text_cn: 于是她向他弯着身，嘲弄着暴君，用祖国的话这样对他说：“我儿，你怜恤我罢！我在腹中怀育你九个月，三年哺养你，又栽培提携养育你，直到现在的年纪。

text_en: I beg you, my child, to look at the heaven and the earth and see everything that is in them, and recognize that God did not make them out of things that existed. And in the same way the human race came into being.
text_cn: 我儿，我恳求你仰视天，俯视地，观察天地间形形色色的万物！你该知道，这一切都是天主从无中造成的，人类也是如此造成的。

text_en: Do not fear this butcher, but prove worthy of your brothers. Accept death, so that in God’s mercy I may get you back again along with your brothers. ”
text_cn: 你不要怕这刽子手，反该对得起你的哥哥们，视死如归，好叫我在天主显示仁慈的时候，可迎接你的哥哥和你！”

text_en: While she was still speaking, the young man said, “What are you waiting for? I will not obey the king’s command, but I obey the command of the law that was given to our ancestors through Moses.
text_cn: 她刚说完了话，青年人就说：“你们还等什么？我决不听从国王的命令，我只听从梅瑟给我们祖宗立定的法律命令。

text_en: But you, who have contrived all sorts of evil against the Hebrews, will certainly not escape the hands of God.
text_cn: 你这设法迫害希伯来人的罪魁，你决不能逃脱天主的手！

text_en: For we are suffering because of our own sins.
text_cn: 我们受难是为了我们的罪恶。

text_en: And if our living Lord is angry for a little while, to rebuke and discipline us, he will again be reconciled with his own servants.
text_cn: 我们永生的上主，为责罚和惩戒我们，一时向我们发怒，但终究要与自己的仆人重新和好。

text_en: But you, unholy wretch, you most defiled of all mortals, do not be elated in vain and puffed up by uncertain hopes, when you raise your hand against the children of heaven.
text_cn: 至于你这恶人！你这人类中的妖孽！你虽然伸手毒害上天的子女，可是，别糊里糊涂，洋洋得意，妙想天开，

text_en: You have not yet escaped the judgment of the almighty, all-seeing God.
text_cn: 因为你逃脱不了全能全知天主的审判。

text_en: For our brothers after enduring a brief suffering have drunk of ever-flowing life, under God’s covenant; but you, by the judgment of God, will receive just punishment for your arrogance.
text_cn: 我哥哥们既忍受了暂时的苦痛，如今他们按照天主的盟约，得到了永生，你却因着天主的审判，将受你骄傲应得的刑罚，

text_en: I, like my brothers, give up body and life for the laws of our ancestors, appealing to God to show mercy soon to our nation and by trials and plagues to make you confess that he alone is God,
text_cn: 我要如同我哥哥们一样，甘心为祖宗的法律，舍弃我的肉身和生命，求上主早日怜恤我们的百姓，并用苦难与灾祸，迫使你承认他是唯一的天主。

text_en: and through me and my brothers to bring to an end the wrath of the Almighty that has justly fallen on our whole nation. ”
text_cn: 愿全能者向我们全族所发的义怒，在我和我哥哥们身上，就此止息。”

text_en: The king fell into a rage, and handled him worse than the others, being exasperated at his scorn.
text_cn: 国王难以忍受他的凌辱，于是勃然大怒，加给他的刑罚比对别的更凶残。

text_en: So he died in his integrity, putting his whole trust in the Lord.
text_cn: 这样，这个纯洁的少年一心依靠上主，走入了另一世界。

text_en: Last of all, the mother died, after her sons.
text_cn: 儿子们相继致命，最后母亲也致了命。

text_en: Let this be enough, then, about the eating of sacrifices and the extreme tortures.
text_cn: 以上所述，足以叫人明了当时关于吃祭品和因此而掀起的惨酷的刑罚。
